summaryEn: Evaluates world simulators with human feedback and video-to-control consistency.

wmNote: 包含感知与操作两个评测层面；衍生反馈数据不应作为独立采集视频重复计数。
wmNoteEn: Perceptual and manipulative evaluations are distinct; derived feedback data must not be counted as independently captured video.

evidence.locator: Abstract; Explicit Perceptual and Implicit Manipulative Evaluation
evidence.statement: The protocol explicitly assesses world simulators in gaming, driving and robot manipulation. Its manipulative evaluation measures whether predicted situation-aware videos translate into correct controls in dynamic environments.
